route_totals.route_total: Mutually exclusive alternatives. Nuclear: one reactor, +8% nuclear generation, +4% nuclear fuel consumption, Treasury cost 2.25% of current GDP (about $4.990 billion at the $221.798 billion 1970 GDP anchor). Distributed: two renewable levels with two extra shared slots, +8% renewable generation, +3% electrical generation factor, $8.5 billion fixed cost.
route_totals.compatibility: These endpoint rewards cannot be summed together; original exclusivity is preserved.

route_totals.route: Electronics capacity followed by precision tooling
route_totals.route_total: The two sequential, compatible capital milestones total 4.25% of current GDP, about $9.426 billion at the $221.798 billion 1970 GDP anchor. The exact charge changes with current GDP.
route_totals.compatibility: Microelectronics capacity is the prerequisite of precision tools; neither excludes the other.

route_totals.route_total: +1 industrial_complex in state 615 and +1 shared slot; one 50% CAT_industry research bonus; fixed treasury cost $2.000 billion plus 0.75% of current GDP (about $3.663 billion at the $221.798 billion 1970 GDP anchor). Party modifier remains active only while LDP governs. LDP A follow-up, mutually exclusive with LDP B.
route_totals.compatibility: This is a marginal single-focus cost, not a cumulative total across rival party platforms. LDP A/B follow-ups are mutually exclusive; each party route requires its actual ruling-party gate.

gdp_price_basis.calibration_note: Capital rewards use deliberate January 1970 GDP shares sized to their actual facility and policy scale; the old nominal treasury amounts were not copied into GDP shares. The 1970 GDP figure supplies only the displayed comparison amount. Actual payment remains a percentage of current GDP.
gdp_price_basis.capital_reward_share_policy: See the revised 12 capital-policy shares in the national reward records; each has a concrete dynamic native treasury preview.

COLDWAR_JAP_1970_article9_self_defence.name: Article 9 and Self-Defence
COLDWAR_JAP_1970_article9_self_defence.description: Japan's postwar settlement places constitutional limits on military power while permitting forces organised for national self-defence.

COLDWAR_JAP_1970_revised_defence_constit.name: Revised Defence Constitution
COLDWAR_JAP_1970_revised_defence_constit.description: A revised constitutional basis authorises a broader defence mission, with higher personnel costs and domestic political strain.

COLDWAR_JAP_1970_article9_retained_manda.name: Constitutional Mandate Renewed
COLDWAR_JAP_1970_article9_retained_manda.description: The referendum confirms Article 9 and renews public support for the existing constitutional settlement for two years.
